in_sanskrit.name: ज्यानिक्षा
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who has the limit or end of knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ज्यानि (Jyani) - knowledge क्षा (Ksha) - limit or end Therefore, Jyaniksha can be interpreted as 'One who has the limit or end of knowledge'.

in_hindi.name: ज्यानिक्षा
in_hindi.meaning: ज्यानि (Jyani) - ज्ञान (Jnana) - विद्या (Vidya) - knowledge क्षा (Ksha) - अंत (Anta) - end or limit Therefore, Jyaniksha can be interpreted as 'One who has the end or limit of knowledge'.

in_tamil.name: ஜ்யானிக்ஷா
in_tamil.meaning: ஜ்யானி (Jyani) - ஜ்ஞானம் (Jnana) - விஜ்யம் (Vijyam) - knowledge க்ஷா (Ksha) - அம்ப (Amb) - end or limit Therefore, Jyaniksha can be interpreted as 'One who has the end or limit of knowledge'.

in_telugu.name: జ్యానిక్షా
in_telugu.meaning: జ్యాని (Jyani) - జ్ఞానము (Jnana) - విజ్యా (Vijya) - knowledge క్షా (Ksha) - అభ్యర్థ (Abhartha) - end or limit Therefore, Jyaniksha can be interpreted as 'One who has the end or limit of knowledge'.

in_marathi.name: Jyaniksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyaniksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyaniksha is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words ‘jnana’ meaning knowledge and ‘iksha’ meaning inquisitive or insightful. This name is often given to girls who are believed to be deeply knowledgeable and inquisitive by nature. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and learning, is often invoked for the blessings of knowledge and wisdom.
